summary.business_type: Local hospitality: tented camp and campsite near Sekenani Gate, Masai Mara, with safari packages
top_findings: 32-page /v2/ duplicate site is indexable and listed in the sitemap
Three sources write duplicate meta descriptions, canonicals and OG tags; the first description is scraped menu text
WordPress default pages (Hello World, Sample Page, /10-2/, Uncategorized) are indexable and in the sitemap
No analytics: MonsterInsights reports 'No tracking code set'
Homepage title is 'Home'; other titles run to about 83 characters
quick_wins: Noindex /v2/ and remove it from the sitemap
Turn off duplicate meta and OG output
Shorten the site title and set a homepage title

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http and www redirect to https apex

findings.title: /v2/ duplicate site indexable
findings.description: /v2/ and /v2/tents/ return 200, index,follow, self-canonical; 32 /v2/ URLs in page-sitemap1.xml.
findings.recommendation: Move to staging or noindex and remove from the sitemap; 301 to the live URLs at launch.

findings.title: WordPress default pages indexable
findings.description: /hello-world/, /sample-page/, /10-2/ and /category/uncategorized/ are live and in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Delete them and confirm they drop out of the sitemap.

findings.title: Duplicate head tags
findings.description: 2 canonicals, 3 meta descriptions, 2 og:title per page.
findings.recommendation: Keep one source of SEO tags.

findings.title: No analytics
findings.description: MonsterInsights comment: No tracking code set.
findings.recommendation: Connect GA4 and verify Search Console.

findings.title: Overlap with kambucampers.com
findings.description: Both domains have 3-day Masai Mara safari pages and pages about the camp.
findings.recommendation: Assign one ranking page per topic across the two sites.

findings.title: Rating figures differ between sites
findings.description: 9.4/251 Booking.com here vs 4.8/412 in kambucampers.com schema.
findings.recommendation: Use the same review figures on both sites.

findings.title: Titles too long
findings.description: 64-character site name appended to every title.
findings.recommendation: Shorten the site title to 'Kambu Mara Camp'.

findings.title: Scraped text as meta description
findings.description: First description begins 'Skip to contentWhatsAppBook now...'.
findings.recommendation: Use the theme's hand-written descriptions only.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Campground with address, geo, phone, priceRange and amenities

findings.title: Overlapping schema blocks
findings.description: Two Organizations (one with an empty name) and three BreadcrumbLists per page.

findings.title: Campground missing properties
findings.description: No image, sameAs, checkinTime or checkoutTime.
findings.recommendation: Add them; leave out self-serving aggregateRating.

findings.title: Heavy pages
findings.description: /reviews/ about 680 KB HTML and 239 images; /v2/ about 490 KB.
findings.recommendation: Paginate reviews; measure real Core Web Vitals.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Specific facts that can be quoted

findings.title: Inconsistent entity signals
findings.description: Scraped descriptions, no og:image, no sameAs, name and ratings differ across sister sites.
findings.recommendation: Clean up meta, add sameAs, align the camp's details across sites.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No missing alt attributes on checked pages

findings.title: No og:image
findings.description: No og:image tag on any page checked.
findings.recommendation: Add a default 1200x630 image plus one per page.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Divide topics between the two sites
